reviews.outcome: MILLER-CT-03 repairs the garbage-row containment condition. The enumeration entry must explicitly ensure all row labels are allocated, retired rows remain enumerable and distinct, the set of retired endpoints is computable, and its omitted endpoints admit the required computable enumeration. Choosing strictly increasing even retirement endpoints ensures an infinite omitted supply. The c.e.-set numbering is not identified with a numbering of all partial functions. The Nerode proof uses a bounded finite computation convention; a computable query bound alone does not certify uniform totality.
